recipes.name: Tagliatelle al Ragù alla Bolognese
recipes.description: Slow-simmered meat ragù from Bologna clinging to fresh egg tagliatelle - Italy's defining pasta.

steps.instruction: Sweat soffritto in butter and oil; add pancetta, then brown the beef.
Deglaze with wine; add passata, cover and simmer gently 2 hours.
Stir in milk near the end; season.
Toss with just-drained tagliatelle and serve with parmesan.

videos.videoTitle: Classic Tagliatelle al Ragu Bolognese | Pasta Bolognese | Food Channel L Recipes

recipes.name: Ossobuco alla Milanese
recipes.description: Veal-shank classic of Milan braised with white wine and broth; here made with beef shank for everyday kitchens.

steps.instruction: Dust shanks with flour; brown deeply in butter on both sides.
Soften vegetables in the same pot; return shanks, add wine and reduce.
Add stock to half-cover; braise covered at low heat ~2 hours.
Rest, then finish with lemon zest and serve with risotto or polenta.

videos.videoTitle: How to make Ossobuco alla milanese

recipes.name: Stracotto al Barolo
recipes.description: Pot roast slowly braised in Barolo wine until spoon-tender - Sunday comfort from Piedmont.

steps.instruction: Sear the roast on all sides in hot oil; set aside.
Cook vegetables and herbs; return beef, pour over wine.
Cover tightly and braise at 150°C for about 3 hours, turning once.
Reduce the cooking liquid into a sauce; slice and serve.

recipes.name: Bistecca alla Fiorentina
recipes.description: Thick-cut T-bone grilled rare over embers with nothing but salt, pepper and olive oil.

steps.instruction: Bring the steak to room temperature; season generously.
Grill over blazing-hot embers 5-6 minutes per side for rare.
Stand the steak upright to render the bone side 2 minutes.
Rest 8 minutes, carve off the bone and dress with oil and pepper.

videos.videoTitle: Bistecca alla Fiorentina - Italy's Most Famous Steak at the Best Steakhouse in Florence!

recipes.name: Bistecca Fiorentina
recipes.description: Thick-cut T-bone steak seasoned with rosemary, garlic, and extra virgin olive oil, grilled over high heat

steps.instruction: Remove steak from refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking and pat dry
Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides
Heat a grill or cast iron pan to very high heat
Grill steak 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare
Let rest 5 minutes before slicing against the grain
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with rosemary

recipes.name: Ragu alla Napoletana
recipes.description: Slow-cooked Neapolitan meat sauce with pork, beef, and tomato, perfect with pasta or polenta

steps.instruction: Dice onion, carrot, and celery finely
Heat olive oil in a heavy pot and saute vegetables until soft
Add ground meats and brown well, breaking up lumps
Pour in wine and let it evaporate completely
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and bay leaf
Simmer on very low heat for at least 3 hours, stirring occasionally
Season with salt, pepper, and tear in basil before serving

recipes.name: Involtini di Vitello
recipes.description: Thin veal rolls stuffed with prosciutto and sage, pan-fried and finished in white wine sauce

steps.instruction: Pound veal cutlets thin and season with salt and pepper
Place a slice of prosciutto and two sage leaves on each cutlet
Roll tightly and secure with kitchen twine or toothpicks
Dust lightly with flour, shaking off excess
Heat oil and butter in a pan and brown rolls on all sides
Deglaze with white wine and add broth
Cover and simmer 20 minutes until tender

recipes.name: Brasato al Barolo
recipes.description: Beef braised slowly in Barolo wine with warm spices until fork-tender

steps.instruction: Cut beef into large chunks and season with salt and pepper
Brown meat well in olive oil on all sides, then set aside
Saute diced onion, carrot, and celery in the same pot
Add garlic, spices, and tomato paste, cook 1 minute
Return beef and pour in Barolo wine and broth
Cover and braise in a 160C oven for 3 hours
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing and serving with braising liquid

recipes.name: Bollito Misto
recipes.description: Classic Northern Italian platter of mixed meats simmered in aromatic broth, served with sauces

steps.instruction: Place all meats in a large pot and cover with cold water
Bring to a gentle simmer, skimming any foam that rises
Add vegetables, bay leaves, peppercorns, and salt
Simmer gently for 2-3 hours until all meats are tender
Remove meats and let rest 10 minutes before slicing
Serve sliced meats with cooking broth, salsa verde, and mostarda

recipes.name: Stracotto
recipes.description: Beef pot roast cooked very slowly in wine and aromatics until it falls apart

steps.instruction: Season beef generously with salt and pepper
Heat olive oil and brown meat on all sides in a heavy pot
Remove meat and saute vegetables until golden
Add tomato paste and cook 1 minute
Return beef, add wine and broth, bring to a simmer
Cover tightly and cook in a 150C oven for 4-5 hours
Shred meat with forks and serve with reduced cooking liquid

recipes.name: Peperonata con Manzo
recipes.description: Beef strips sauteed with sweet peppers, tomatoes, and onions in a rustic one-pan dish

steps.instruction: Slice beef into thin strips and season with salt and pepper
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over high heat
Sear beef quickly in batches, set aside
Saute sliced peppers and onions until softened
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
Add tomatoes and oregano, simmer 10 minutes
Return beef, toss together, and serve topped with basil

recipes.name: Polpettone
recipes.description: Italian-style meatloaf with mortadella, parmesan, and egg, baked until golden

steps.instruction: Soak breadcrumbs in milk for 5 minutes
Mix ground beef with mortadella, parmesan, egg, and soaked breadcrumbs
Add finely chopped onion, garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper
Shape into a loaf and place in a buttered baking dish
Dot top with remaining butter
Bake at 180C for about 1 hour until golden and cooked through
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing

recipes.name: Tagliata di Manzo
recipes.description: Grilled sirloin steak sliced and served over arugula with parmesan shavings

steps.instruction: Bring steak to room temperature and season with salt and pepper
Grill over high heat 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare
Rest the steak for 5 minutes, then slice against the grain
Arrange arugula on plates and top with sliced steak
Scatter cherry tomatoes and parmesan shavings over top
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze

recipes.name: Carne all'Ingiusta
recipes.description: Tender beef braised in red wine with olives and capers from Puglia

steps.instruction: Cut beef into large chunks and season with salt and pepper
Brown meat in olive oil in a heavy pot
Add sliced onion and cook until softened
Pour in wine and let it reduce by half
Add passata, bay leaves, and oregano
Cover and simmer gently for 2.5 hours
Add olives and capers in the last 20 minutes
Adjust seasoning and serve

recipes.name: Manzo al Pepe
recipes.description: Beef medallions in a creamy black pepper sauce, quick and elegant

steps.instruction: Crush peppercorns coarsely and press onto beef medallions
Heat butter in a skillet and sear medallions 2 minutes per side
Remove beef and saute finely diced shallot
Deglaze with cognac and let it reduce
Add broth and cream, simmer until slightly thickened
Return medallions to warm through in the sauce
Serve immediately with the pepper cream sauce

recipes.name: Bistecca alla Pizzaiola
recipes.description: Beef steak topped with a rustic tomato, garlic, and oregano sauce

steps.instruction: Season steak with salt and pepper on both sides
Heat olive oil and sear steak 3-4 minutes per side
Remove steak and in the same pan add sliced garlic
Cook garlic briefly then add crushed tomatoes and oregano
Simmer sauce 10 minutes until thickened
Return steak to pan and spoon sauce over top
Garnish with basil and serve

recipes.name: Goulash Italiano
recipes.description: Italian-style goulash with beef, paprika, and peppers in a rich sauce

steps.instruction: Cut beef into 3cm cubes and season with salt and pepper
Brown meat in batches in hot olive oil
Saute sliced onions until golden
Add paprika and caraway seeds, stir 30 seconds
Return beef, add tomatoes, broth, and diced pepper
Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours
Adjust seasoning and serve with crusty bread

recipes.name: Spezzatino di Manzo
recipes.description: Tender Italian beef stew with potatoes, peas, and a touch of tomato

steps.instruction: Cut beef into cubes and season with salt and pepper
Brown meat in olive oil in a heavy pot
Add diced onion, carrot, and celery, cook until soft
Stir in tomato paste and cook 1 minute
Deglaze with wine, then add broth
Cover and simmer 1.5 hours until beef is nearly tender
Add potatoes and cook 20 more minutes
Add peas in the last 5 minutes and adjust seasoning

recipes.name: Brasato al Vino Rosso
recipes.description: Beef braised in dry red wine with rosemary and root vegetables

steps.instruction: Cut beef into large chunks and season well
Brown in olive oil on all sides in a heavy pot
Remove meat and saute diced vegetables until golden
Add tomato paste and cook 1 minute
Return beef and pour in wine and broth
Add rosemary and bay leaves
Cover and braise in a 160C oven for 3 hours
Rest 10 minutes before serving with sauce

recipes.name: Polpette in Sugo
recipes.description: Classic Italian meatballs simmered in a simple tomato sauce

steps.instruction: Mix ground meats with breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, garlic, and parsley
Season with salt and pepper and form into walnut-sized balls
Heat olive oil and brown meatballs on all sides
Remove and in the same pan saute diced onion
Add crushed tomatoes and oregano, simmer 10 minutes
Return meatballs and simmer gently 20 minutes
Serve with pasta or crusty bread

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.description: Classic hunter-style chicken braised with tomatoes, bell peppers, mushrooms and white wine.

steps.instruction: Season chicken; sear in olive oil until browned on both sides. Remove.
Sauté onion, peppers and mushrooms until softened.
Deglaze with wine; add tomatoes and oregano.
Return chicken to the pan; cover and braise on low heat 35 minutes.
Uncover, reduce sauce to taste, season and serve.

recipes.name: Pollo alla Milanese
recipes.description: Golden breaded chicken cutlet fried until crisp - Milanese simplicity at its best.

steps.instruction: Dredge cutlets in flour, then egg, then cheesy breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry in medium-hot oil about 3 minutes per side until deep gold.
Drain on a rack; salt immediately.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Pollo al Limone
recipes.description: Skillet chicken cutlets in a bright lemon-butter sauce, ready in under half an hour.

steps.instruction: Lightly flour the cutlets; sauté in oil until golden and cooked through.
Remove chicken; add lemon juice and stock to the pan, simmering to reduce.
Swirl in cold butter for a glossy sauce; add capers if using.
Return chicken to coat; serve with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmigiana
recipes.description: Italian-American icon: crisp cutlets baked under tomato sauce and molten mozzarella.

steps.instruction: Bread the cutlets flour-egg-crumb; shallow-fry until golden on both sides.
Spread sauce in a baking dish; lay in cutlets and cover with more sauce.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake at 200°C for 15-20 minutes until bubbling; finish with basil.

videos.videoTitle: Crispy Chicken Parmigiana (Pollo alla Parmigiana) | Italian-American Comfort Food

recipes.name: Pollo alla Romana
recipes.description: Chicken pieces braised with tomatoes, bell peppers, and white wine in Roman style

steps.instruction: Season chicken pieces with salt and pepper
Heat olive oil and brown chicken on all sides, set aside
Saute sliced peppers and onion until softened
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
Pour in wine and let it reduce
Add tomatoes and oregano, simmer 10 minutes
Return chicken, cover and cook 25 minutes until done

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Pollo alla Romana - Roman Style Chicken

recipes.name: Pollo Arrosto
recipes.description: Whole roast chicken with lemon, garlic, and herbs until skin is golden and crispy

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 200C
Pat chicken dry and rub with olive oil, salt, and pepper
Stuff cavity with lemon, garlic, and herbs
Arrange quartered potatoes around the chicken
Roast for 1 hour, basting every 20 minutes
Rest 10 minutes before carving
Serve with the roasted potatoes and pan juices

recipes.name: Pollo alla Cacciatora
recipes.description: Hunter-style chicken braised with tomatoes, mushrooms, and herbs

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt and pepper
Brown chicken in olive oil, set aside
Saute onion and mushrooms until golden
Add garlic and herbs, cook 30 seconds
Pour in wine and let it reduce slightly
Add tomatoes and return chicken to the pan
Cover and simmer 30 minutes until chicken is cooked through

recipes.name: Pollo Ripieno
recipes.description: Stuffed chicken breast with spinach, ricotta, and pine nuts, baked in foil

steps.instruction: Cook spinach briefly, squeeze dry, and chop finely
Mix ricotta with spinach, pine nuts, parmesan, egg, and garlic
Cut a pocket in each chicken breast and season inside
Fill pockets with the spinach mixture and secure with toothpicks
Heat olive oil and brown chicken on all sides
Wrap in foil and bake at 180C for 25 minutes
Rest 5 minutes before slicing

recipes.name: Pollo alla Milanese Classic
recipes.description: Thinly pounded chicken coated in golden breadcrumbs, a Milanese classic

steps.instruction: Pound chicken breasts to 5mm thickness
Set up breading station: flour, beaten eggs, breadcrumbs
Season chicken with salt and pepper
Dredge in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs, pressing to adhere
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Fry chicken 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crispy
Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges

recipes.name: Pollo alla Piastra
recipes.description: Grilled chicken breast marinated in garlic and herbs, served with lemon

steps.instruction: Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and herbs for marinade
Marinate chicken for at least 30 minutes
Preheat grill or grill pan to high heat
Grill chicken 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing
Serve with a squeeze of fresh lemon

recipes.name: Pollo con Peperoni
recipes.description: Chicken pieces braised with sweet peppers, onions, and tomato

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt and pepper
Brown in olive oil and set aside
Saute sliced peppers and onions until soft
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
Pour in wine and let it reduce
Add tomatoes and oregano, simmer 5 minutes
Return chicken, cover and cook 25 minutes

recipes.name: Pollo al Curry Italiano
recipes.description: Chicken in a mild Italian-style curry with cream, saffron, and a touch of tomato

steps.instruction: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season
Heat olive oil and brown chicken, set aside
Saute diced onion until softened
Add garlic and curry powder, cook 1 minute
Add saffron, tomatoes, and broth, bring to a simmer
Return chicken and cook 20 minutes until tender
Stir in cream and serve over basmati rice

recipes.name: Pollo alle Olive
recipes.description: Chicken braised with green olives, capers, and a white wine sauce

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt and pepper
Brown in olive oil and set aside
Saute diced onion until translucent
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
Pour in wine and broth, bring to a simmer
Return chicken, add olives and capers
Cover and cook 25 minutes until done
Sprinkle with parsley before serving

recipes.name: Pollo al Marsala
recipes.description: Chicken breast pan-fried and finished in a Marsala wine and mushroom sauce

steps.instruction: Pound chicken breasts to even thickness
Season and dredge in flour
Melt half the butter and cook chicken until golden, set aside
Add remaining butter and saute mushrooms until browned
Pour in Marsala wine and broth, simmer 2 minutes
Return chicken to the pan and coat with sauce
Sprinkle with parsley and serve

recipes.name: Pollo in Padella
recipes.description: Simple pan-seared chicken thighs with garlic, white wine, and fresh herbs

steps.instruction: Season chicken with salt and pepper
Heat olive oil and sear chicken skin-side down until crispy
Flip and cook 3 more minutes
Add garlic cloves and herbs to the pan
Pour in wine and broth, simmer 3 minutes
Baste chicken with the pan sauce
Serve immediately with sauce spooned over

recipes.name: Pollo Fritto
recipes.description: Southern Italian fried chicken pieces marinated in milk and herbs

steps.instruction: Soak chicken pieces in milk with lemon juice for 1 hour
Mix flour with salt, pepper, rosemary, and garlic
Heat oil in a deep pan to 170C
Dredge chicken in seasoned flour, shaking off excess
Fry in batches for 12-15 minutes until golden and cooked through
Drain on paper towels
Serve hot with lemon wedges

recipes.name: Pollo ai Funghi
recipes.description: Chicken breast cooked in a creamy mushroom and white wine sauce

steps.instruction: Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper
Heat oil and butter, cook chicken until golden, set aside
Saute shallot and garlic until soft
Add mushrooms and cook until browned
Pour in wine and let it reduce
Add cream and simmer 3 minutes
Return chicken, coat with sauce, and serve with parsley

recipes.name: Pollo alla Diavola
recipes.description: Spicy butterflied chicken marinated in hot chili and paprika, grilled over charcoal

steps.instruction: Butterfly the chicken and pound flat
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, chili, paprika, and rosemary
Marinate chicken for at least 2 hours
Pat dry and season with salt and pepper
Grill over medium-high heat 8-10 minutes per side
Rest 5 minutes before carving
Serve with lemon wedges and a green salad

recipes.name: Crostini Toscani
recipes.description: Toasted bread topped with a savory chicken liver pate, a Tuscan favourite

steps.instruction: Clean chicken livers and trim any sinew
Melt half the butter and cook livers until just pink inside
Add cognac and let it evaporate
Transfer to a food processor with capers, anchovies, and cornichons
Blend until smooth, season with salt and pepper
Toast bread slices and brush with olive oil
Spread pate generously on toast and serve

recipes.name: Pollo alla Valdostana
recipes.description: Chicken breast baked with fontina cheese, ham, and white wine from Aosta Valley

steps.instruction: Butterfly chicken breasts and pound slightly
Season with salt and pepper and dredge in flour
Melt butter in an oven-safe skillet and brown chicken
Layer prosciutto and fontina on each breast
Pour wine around the chicken
Transfer to a 190C oven and bake 15 minutes
Garnish with parsley and serve

recipes.name: Spaghetti al Pomodoro
recipes.description: The Italian classic: al dente spaghetti tossed in a glossy San Marzano tomato basil sauce with olive oil and parmesan.

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta.
Sizzle garlic in olive oil, add crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes; season.
Cook spaghetti until al dente, reserving a cup of pasta water.
Toss pasta in the sauce with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Finish with torn basil and grated parmesan.

recipes.name: Risotto ai Funghi
recipes.description: Creamy Arborio rice stirred with porcini and field mushrooms, finished with parmesan.

steps.instruction: Sauté mushrooms in half the butter until golden; season and reserve.
Soften onion; toast rice; deglaze with wine.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, ~18 minutes until creamy.
Fold in mushrooms, porcini and their strained soaking liquid early in cooking.
Beat in cold butter and parmesan off heat; rest 1 minute.

recipes.name: Parmigiana di Melanzane
recipes.description: Layers of fried eggplant, tomato, basil, mozzarella and parmesan baked into southern Italy's proudest bake.

steps.instruction: Salt eggplant slices 30 minutes; pat dry, dust with flour, fry until gold; drain.
Simmer crushed tomatoes with basil and salt 15 minutes.
Layer sauce, eggplant, mozzarella and parmesan twice over in a dish.
Top with parmesan; bake at 190°C for 40 minutes; rest 15 before serving.

recipes.name: Minestrone della Nonna
recipes.description: Hearty vegetable-and-bean soup thickened with pasta - grandma's flexible seasonal classic.

steps.instruction: Soften the soffritto in olive oil in a large pot.
Add tomatoes, potatoes and zucchini; cook 5 minutes.
Pour in stock; simmer 25 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Add beans and pasta; cook 10 more minutes; season generously.

recipes.name: Pizza Margherita
recipes.description: Naples' flag on a plate: blistered crust, San Marzano tomato, fior di latte and basil.

steps.instruction: Stretch dough into two 30cm rounds; keep a raised rim.
Spread crushed tomatoes; scatter mozzarella and a pinch of salt.
Bake on a preheated pizza stone at maximum oven heat 6-8 minutes.
Finish with basil and olive oil; slice and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Minestrone
recipes.description: Hearty Italian vegetable soup with beans, pasta, and seasonal vegetables

steps.instruction: Dice all vegetables into small cubes
Heat olive oil and saute onion, carrot, and celery
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
Add potato, zucchini, and tomatoes
Pour in enough water to cover and add parmesan rind
Simmer 20 minutes until vegetables are tender
Add pasta and beans, cook 10 more minutes
Season and serve with basil and a drizzle of olive oil

videos.videoTitle: Homemade Minestrone Soup | Keep Cooking & Carry On | Jamie Oliver

recipes.name: Pasta e Fagioli
recipes.description: Classic pasta and bean soup, thick and warming with rosemary and tomato

steps.instruction: Mash half the beans roughly with a fork
Heat olive oil and saute diced onion, carrot, and celery
Add garlic and rosemary, cook 1 minute
Add tomatoes and cook 3 minutes
Pour in broth and add mashed and whole beans
Simmer 15 minutes, then add pasta
Cook until pasta is al dente, season and serve

recipes.name: Caponata Siciliana
recipes.description: Sweet and sour Sicilian eggplant stew with celery, olives, and capers

steps.instruction: Salt eggplant cubes and let drain 30 minutes, then pat dry
Fry eggplant in olive oil until golden, set aside
Saute onion and celery until softened
Add tomatoes and cook 5 minutes
Return eggplant, add olives and capers
Mix vinegar with sugar and pour over
Simmer 10 minutes and cool to room temperature
Serve with basil and a drizzle of olive oil

recipes.name: Peperonata
recipes.description: Slow-cooked sweet peppers with tomatoes, onions, and garlic

steps.instruction: Slice peppers into thick strips and dice onion
Heat olive oil and cook onions until softened
Add peppers and cook over medium heat 15 minutes
Add garlic and cook 1 minute
Add tomatoes and oregano
Simmer gently for 30 minutes until very soft
Season, tear in basil, and serve warm or at room temperature

recipes.name: Carciofi alla Romana
recipes.description: Roman-style artichokes braised with lemon, garlic, and mint until meltingly tender

steps.instruction: Trim artichokes, removing tough outer leaves and cutting stems
Rub with lemon to prevent browning
Stuff each artichoke with garlic, mint, and parsley
Place artichokes upside down in a pan
Add olive oil, wine, broth, salt, and pepper
Cover and braise over low heat for 35-40 minutes
Serve warm with braising liquid spooned over

recipes.name: Fave e Cicoria
recipes.description: Creamy fava bean puree served with sauteed bitter greens, a Puglian classic

steps.instruction: Drain soaked fava beans and cook in salted water until very soft, about 1 hour
Mash beans into a thick puree, seasoning with salt
Blanch chicory in salted water for 3 minutes, drain
Saute chicory with garlic and olive oil until wilted
Serve fava puree on plates topped with chicory
Drizzle generously with olive oil

recipes.name: Bruschetta al Pomodoro
recipes.description: Grilled bread rubbed with garlic and topped with fresh tomatoes and basil

steps.instruction: Dice tomatoes and toss with olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper
Let marinate for 15 minutes
Grill bread slices until golden on both sides
Rub each slice with a halved garlic clove
Top bread with tomato mixture
Tear basil over the top and drizzle with olive oil
Serve immediately

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Italian BRUSCHETTA - Easy Appetizer

recipes.name: Frittata di Verdure
recipes.description: Thick Italian omelette loaded with seasonal vegetables and parmesan

steps.instruction: Beat eggs with parmesan, parsley, salt, and pepper
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet
Saute vegetables until softened, about 5 minutes
Pour egg mixture over vegetables
Cook on low heat until edges are set, about 5 minutes
Transfer to a broiler and cook 3 minutes until puffed
Let cool slightly, slice into wedges and serve

recipes.name: Gnocchi al Pesto
recipes.description: Soft potato dumplings tossed in fragrant basil pesto with green beans and potatoes

steps.instruction: Boil small potatoes and green beans in salted water until tender
In the same pot, cook gnocchi until they float
Drain, reserving some cooking water
Toss gnocchi with pesto, beans, potatoes, and a splash of cooking water
Add olive oil and adjust consistency
Serve with grated parmesan on top

recipes.name: Pasta alla Norma
recipes.description: Rigatoni with eggplant, tomato sauce, ricotta salata, and fresh basil

steps.instruction: Salt eggplant cubes and let drain 20 minutes, pat dry
Fry eggplant in olive oil until golden, set aside
In the same pan, saute garlic briefly
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes
Cook rigatoni in salted water until al dente
Toss pasta with sauce and eggplant
Serve with shaved ricotta salata and basil

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.description: Spaghetti tossed with garlic, olive oil, chili flakes, and parsley

steps.instruction: Cook spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente
Heat olive oil over low heat and gently cook sliced garlic until golden
Add chili flakes and cook 30 seconds
Reserve pasta water then drain spaghetti
Toss spaghetti with garlic oil and pasta water
Add parsley and toss well
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Insalata Tricolore
recipes.description: Classic Italian salad of arugula, radicchio, and endive with parmesan shavings

steps.instruction: Wash and dry all salad greens
Tear larger leaves into bite-sized pieces
Arrange on plates alternating the three colors
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice
Season with salt and pepper
Top with parmesan shavings
Serve immediately

recipes.name: Panzanella Toscana
recipes.description: Tuscan bread salad with ripe tomatoes, red onion, basil, and a vinegar dressing

steps.instruction: Tear stale bread into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl
Soak bread with a little water for 5 minutes, then squeeze dry
Add tomato wedges, sliced onion, and diced cucumber
Tear basil leaves and scatter over the top
Whisk vinegar with olive oil, salt, and pepper
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently
Let rest 15 minutes before serving for flavors to meld

recipes.name: Insalata Mista
recipes.description: Fresh Italian mixed green salad

steps.instruction: Wash and dry all greens.
Slice cucumber and halve tomatoes.
Toss with olive oil and balsamic.
Season with salt and garnish with basil.

recipes.name: Affettati Misti
recipes.description: Selection of Italian cured meats with marinated vegetables and crusty bread

steps.instruction: Slice cured meats thinly and arrange on a large board
Drain and arrange marinated artichokes alongside
Add sun-dried tomatoes and olives to the board
Slice crusty bread and arrange around the board
Drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze over the meats
Let come to room temperature before serving
Serve as a shared starter

recipes.name: Tiramisù
recipes.description: Espresso-soaked savoiardi layered with airy mascarpone cream and cocoa - Italy's most famous dessert.

steps.instruction: Whisk yolks with sugar until pale; fold in mascarpone.
Beat whites to soft peaks and fold through the cream.
Quickly dip biscuits in espresso; line a dish in two layers with cream between.
Chill at least 4 hours; dust heavily with cocoa before serving.

videos.videoTitle: Homemade Tiramisu That Tastes Like Italy

recipes.name: Panna Cotta
recipes.description: Silky set cream with vanilla and a berry coulis - elegant northern Italian minimalism.

steps.instruction: Warm cream, milk, sugar and vanilla until steaming; melt in gelatin off heat.
Strain into ramekins; chill at least 5 hours to set.
Blend and strain berries with a little sugar for coulis.
Turn out or serve in glasses with coulis.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make PANNA COTTA Like an Italian

recipes.name: Cannoli Siciliani
recipes.description: Crisp fried pastry tubes filled with sweet ricotta, chocolate chips, and candied orange

steps.instruction: Drain ricotta overnight in the refrigerator in a fine sieve
Mix ricotta with powdered sugar, vanilla, and cinnamon
Fold in chocolate chips and candied orange peel
Transfer filling to a piping bag
Pipe filling into both ends of each cannoli shell
Dip ends in chopped pistachios
Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately

videos.videoTitle: Homemade Sicilian Cannoli from Scratch | A Warm Day with us in the Kitchen

recipes.name: Sfogliatelle
recipes.description: Layered shell-shaped pastry filled with sweet semolina and ricotta cream

steps.instruction: Cook semolina with a little water until thick, let cool
Mix cooled semolina with ricotta, sugar, egg yolk, candied citron, vanilla, and cinnamon
Roll pastry thinly and brush with melted butter
Roll up tightly into a log and cut into 2cm rounds
Press each round into a muffin tin to form a shell shape
Fill each shell with the semolina mixture
Bake at 190C for 20 minutes until golden and crispy
Dust with powdered sugar and serve warm

videos.videoTitle: Sfogliatella: la ricetta originale di uno dei più difficili dolci italiani con Sabatino Sirica

recipes.name: Cassata Siciliana
recipes.description: Sponge cake soaked in rum syrup, filled with ricotta cream and decorated with marzipan

steps.instruction: Mix rum and orange juice for the soaking syrup
Drain ricotta and mix with powdered sugar and vanilla
Fold in chocolate and candied fruit
Line a loaf tin with cling film and layer sponge cake
Brush each layer with rum syrup
Spread ricotta cream between layers
Cover with more sponge and syrup, refrigerate overnight
Unmold, cover with rolled almond paste, and decorate with pistachios

recipes.name: Bomboloni
recipes.description: Fluffy Italian doughnuts filled with vanilla pastry cream and rolled in sugar

steps.instruction: Dissolve yeast in warm milk and let stand 5 minutes
Mix flour, sugar, and salt, then add eggs, butter, and yeast mixture
Knead until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes
Cover and let rise until doubled, about 1.5 hours
Roll out to 2cm thick and cut rounds with a 7cm cutter
Let rounds rise 30 minutes more
Fry in oil at 170C for 2 minutes per side until golden
Drain, roll in sugar, and fill with pastry cream using a piping bag

recipes.name: Zeppole di San Giuseppe
recipes.description: Choux pastry buns topped with custard cream and an amarena cherry

steps.instruction: Bring water, butter, oil, and salt to a boil
Add flour all at once and stir vigorously until a dough forms
Let cool slightly then beat in eggs one at a time
Pipe large mounds onto a lined baking sheet
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden
Let cool and pipe custard cream on top
Place an amarena cherry on each and dust with powdered sugar

recipes.name: Torta della Nonna
recipes.description: Grandmother's tart with custard cream, pine nuts, and a dusting of powdered sugar

steps.instruction: Mix flour, sugar, and salt, then rub in cold butter until sandy
Add egg yolks, vanilla, and lemon zest, and bring dough together
Wrap and chill for 1 hour
Press two-thirds of dough into a 23cm tart tin
Spread custard cream evenly over the base
Crumble remaining dough over the top and scatter pine nuts
Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until golden
Cool and dust generously with powdered sugar

recipes.name: Cantucci
recipes.description: Twice-baked almond biscuits, crisp and perfect for dipping in Vin Santo

steps.instruction: Beat eggs with sugar until light and frothy
Add vanilla and lemon zest
Fold in flour, baking powder, and salt until a dough forms
Knead in almonds until evenly distributed
Shape into logs about 8cm wide on a lined baking sheet
Bake at 170C for 30 minutes until golden
Let cool 10 minutes then slice diagonally into fingers
Return slices to the oven at 150C for 10 minutes to crisp up

recipes.name: Panforte
recipes.description: Dense Tuscan fruit and nut cake spiced with cinnamon, cloves, and nutmeg

steps.instruction: Chop dried fruit and toast nuts lightly
Warm honey and sugar together until dissolved
Sift flour, cocoa, and spices together
Mix fruit, nuts, honey mixture, and flour until combined
Line a 20cm tin with baking paper and press mixture in firmly
Bake at 160C for 40 minutes
Cool completely in the tin before turning out
Dust with powdered sugar and slice thinly to serve
